requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

643-661-1486-4231--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Maskwood Nexus, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

3293-5411-5721-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5411-5721-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5411-5721-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

5315-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5315-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

2981-3764-7924.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

2445-5254-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-5254-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

1170-2099-3536-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-3536-5131--202.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name the artifact.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2

489-1090-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-4188-4742.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-4742.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2488-6779-7167.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Selfless Spirit by sacrificing it, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
If the opposing creature dealt damage to Apex Altisaur, Apex Altisaur's second ability and Wrathful Raptors trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 4 until your opponents control no creatures. If they happen to control an indestructible creature with power above 0, this loop can be done infinitely.
2488-6779-7167.notes: You can restart the loop if opponents control creatures by dealing damage to Apex Altisaur. It may not have indestructible by this point however unless you use another source to provide it.

3197-6719-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6719-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

661-3685-4659-4985.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Jhoira's Familiar. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7325.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
2292-6972-7325.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

969-1563-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

643-2366-2438-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-2366-2438-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

1491-4549-7065.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Tui and La, adding {1}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Tui and La by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2060-2700-2744-4499-7061.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1818-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
1818-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Healer of the Pride triggers twice, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1621-6556-6867.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
1621-6556-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1669-1850-4426.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1669-1850-4426.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

323-4050-5544.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2239-4558-5256.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2091-2239-4558-5256.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat.

391-2681-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
391-2681-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Blossom Dryad do not have summoning sickness.
391-2681-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

3484-4374-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3484-4374-5870.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls and Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
969-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2459-2644-4763-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
2459-2644-4763-5147.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying commander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Rograkh.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3488-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
3488-4740.description:
Activate Katsumasa by paying {2}{U}, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 3.

3360-3430-4289.notablePrerequisites: Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
3360-3430-4289.description:
Activate Torchling's first ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

356-643-1729-4696.description:
Activate Fleetwheel Cruiser by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target and three damage to itself.
Fleetwheel Cruiser dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Fleetwheel Cruiser that is a Food artifact.
When the Fleetwheel Cruiser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

1940-2034-2124.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
1940-2034-2124.description:
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
When the Knight dies, Liliana triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

890-1692-2410.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Myr Galvanizer.
Myr Galvanizer and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
890-1692-2410.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Myr Galvanizer with haste.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping all other Myr you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1661-2034-4891-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {C}{C}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from the top of your library by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3311-4820-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Snake Umbra attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
3311-4820-4869.description:
Activate Cephalid Inkshrouder by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

2026-3478-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
2026-3478-3525.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.

2478-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2478-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Mishra's Bauble enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
